  Scenario: AC8 Each business rule of section 8 is checked by a criterion and a test (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the business rules BR1 to BR12 of section 8
    When each rule is compared with the criteria of section 7 and the rows of section 16
    Then each of BR1 to BR12 is named by a criterion or by the boundary check of TC-S9-E6029-CON-07
    Then a rule that is an architecture constraint is checked by the guardrail or boundary test named in its row

  Scenario: AC9 The read and the write declare the 404 error answer of the provided operations (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the two operations of AC1 and the error set of the baseline
    When the error answers are compared with the error set
    Then the read and the write each declare 404 among their error answers, with the envelope of the error set
    Then the message ID of the 404 answer is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S9-E6029-CON-AC9) and carries the placeholder
